verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely developer-API-integration documentation (checkouts, SDKs, terminal payment APIs, MCP tools) and pricing page snippets; it contains no evidence about the merchant signup flow, approval/KYC process, or ordering hardware from a dashboard. Missing for 10: signup/onboarding flow docs, approval timeline evidence, hardware ordering/dashboard UI evidence, any first-hand or community account of speed-to-first-payment.
